spans.s:
मिश् मिश् (connected with rt. मश्), cl.
1. P. मेशति, मेशितुम्, to make a noise,
sound; to be angry.

मिष् 1. मिष् [cf. rt. मील्], cl. 6. P. मि-
षति, मिमेष, मेषिष्यति, अमेषीत्,
मेषितुम् (the simple rt. appears to be used only
in the present participle), to open the eyes, have the
eyes open; to look at, look at or look on unwil-
lingly, look on angrily or with the eyes contracted,
wink at (generally used in the present participle,
the construction being that of a genitive absolute,
e. g. मिषतो बन्धु-वर्गस्य, the whole number
of relatives looking helplessly on, i. e. before their
very eyes or in spite of them; मिषतां वः, in
spite of you); to rival, contend with, resist, emulate;
[cf. Gr. μῖσος perhaps also μύω: Lat. mico; per-
haps nico, nic-to, fr. nimic-o, nimic-to = निमि-
षामि: Russ. migaju, mischu, ‘I wink:’ Lith.
mirkloju, ‘I wink;’ mêgmi, ‘I sleep.’]

मिष् 2. मिष् (connected with rt. 3.
मृष्), cl. 1. P. मेषति, मिमेष,
मेषितुम्, to sprinkle, moisten, wet.

मिस् मिस्, cl. 4. P. मिस्यति, &c., Ved.
to go.
मिशर मिशर, N. of a place.

मिसर मिसर, N. of a place, (perhaps =
मिस्र्, Egypt; cf. मिशर.)

मिषि मिषि, इस्, f. spikenard; fennel, &c.,
= मिसि.

मिसि मिसि, इस्, f. a sort of fennel, Anethum
Sowa; Anethum Panmori; common anise, Pimpi-
nella Anisum; spikenard, Nardostachys Jatamansi;
a sort of lovage; = अज-मोदा; = उशीरी; [cf. मिशि,
मिषि.]

मिशृष मिशृष, N. of a place (also
written मिश्रिष).

मिश्र् मिश्र् or मिस्र् (probably a Nom.
fr. मिश्र below), cl. 10. P. मिश्रयति,
मिश्रापयति, &c., to mix, mingle, blend, combine,
unite, mix with (with inst.); to add; [cf. Gr. μίσγ-ω,
μίγ-νυ-μι, ἐ-μίγ-ην, ἐ-μίχθη-ν, μίγ-α, μίγ-δα, μίγ-δην,
μιγ-άδες, μίξις: Lat. misc-e-o, mix-tu-s, mis-
tu-s, mix-tû-ra, mis-tû-ra, mix-ti-o, mis-ti-o,
misc-ellu-s, miscell-âneu-s: Old Germ. miscjan,
misk-iu, ‘mix thou:’ Angl. Sax. miscan: Slav.
mes-i-ti: Lith. misz-ti; misz-ini-s, ‘a mongrel;’
maisz-y-ti, ‘to mix.’]
मिस्र् मिस्र्. See मिश्र्, p. 779, col. 2.

मिश्र, अस्, आ, अम्, (thought by some to be fr. a
lost rt. मिश्, connected with मिक्ष्, desiderative of
rt. 1. मिह्; by others referred to rt. मिश् above),
mixed, mingled, blended, joined; mixed or blended
with (with inst. or sometimes gen.), combined;
associated, connected, (न मिश्रः स्यात् पापकृद्-
भिः, one should not associate with the wicked);
mixing, adulterating (e. g. mixing or adulterating
corn); tangled, intertwined; manifold, diverse; (at
the end of a comp.) having a mixture or mixed
collection of anything, for the most part consisting
of, consisting chiefly of (e. g. बदरी-मिश्रं का-
ननम्, a forest consisting for the most part of
Badarī trees; आर्य-विदग्ध-मिश्रास्, for the most
part worthy and learned persons); (अस्), m. a respect-
able person (cf. आर्य-म्˚; in this sense frequently
used at the end or beginning of a proper name,
especially that of a scholar, by way of respect, cf.
कृष्ण-म्˚, भाव-म्˚, मधु-म्˚; and some-
times used alone as an abbreviation for a name ending
in मिश्र, e. g. मिश्र = मण्डन-मिश्र); N. of the
author of the Karma-pradīpa and of various other
persons; epithet of a kind of elephant; (अम्), n.
mixing, mixture; a species of radish (= चाणक्य-
मूलक).
—मिश्र-केशव, अस्, m., N. of an author
(= केशव-दास).
—मिश्र-केशी, f., N. of an Apsaras.
—मिश्र-चतुर्भुज, अस्, m. a proper N.
—मिश्र-
ज, अस्, m. ‘of mixed birth or breed,’ a mule.
—मिश्र-
जाति, इस्, इस्, इ, being of mixed birth or breed, of
mixed parentage, any one whose parents belong to
different castes.
—मिश्र-ता, f. mixedness, the being
mixed, mixing, mingling.
—मिश्र-दिन-कर, अस्,
m., N. of a commentator on the Śiśupāla-badha.
—मिश्र-धान्य, अस्, आ, अम्, made by mixing
[]
various kinds of grain; (अम्), n. mixed grain.
—मि-
श्र-पुष्पा, f. Trigonella Fœnum Græcum (= मे-
थिका).
—मिश्र-भाव, अस्, m., N. of the author
of the Bhāva-prakāśa, a medical work, (also भाव,
भाव-मिश्र.)
—मिश्र-लटकन, अस्, m., N. of
the father of Miśra-bhāva.
—मिश्र-वर्ण, अस्, आ,
अम्, being of a mixed colour; (अम्), n. a kind of
black aloe wood (= कृष्णागुरु).
—मिश्रवर्ण-
फला, f. Solanum Melongena.
—मिश्र-व्यवहार,
अस्, m. (in arithmetic) investigation of mixture,
ascertainment of composition (as principal and in-
terest joined, &c.).
—मिश्र-शब्द, अस्, m. a mule
(= मिश्र-ज).
—मिश्री-करण, अम्, n. the act of
mixing, an ingredient, seasoning.
—मिश्री-कृ, cl. 8.
-करोति, &c., to make mixed, mix, mingle.
—मिश्री-
भाव, अस्, m. becoming mixed, mixing, mingling.
—मिश्री-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to
become mixed, mix, intertwine.

मिश्रक, अस्, आ, अम्, mixing, adulterating, mingled,
miscellaneous; mixed, adulterated; (अस्), m. a mixer
or compounder; an adulterator of articles of com-
merce, mixer of bad wares with good ones; (अम्),
n. salt produced from salt soil; N. of a Tīrtha; of
a grove or garden of paradise; a particular kind
of song or singing.
—मिश्रका-वण, अम्, n., N. of
Indra's pleasure-grove.

मिश्रण, अम्, n. the act of mixing, uniting; (in
arithmetic) addition.
मिश्रणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be mixed or mingled.

मिश्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, mixed, mingled, blended,
united, joined; added; respected, respectable.
मिश्रिन्, ई, m., N. of a Nāga.

मिश्रेया, f. (connected with मिशि, q. v.), Anethum
Panmori or a species of anise.
मिश्ल = मिश्र in आ-म्˚, नि-म्˚, सम्-म्˚.

मिष, अस्, m. rivalry, emulation, envy; (अम्), n.
deceit, fraud, trick, illusion, false appearance (e. g.
सूद-मिषं श्रितः, having assumed the form of
a cook; दर्शन-मिषात्, under the pretext of
seeing); [cf. मृषा.]

मिष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sprinkled, moistened; nice,
savoury, dainty, delicate; sweet, sugary, (in this sense
thought by some to be for 1. मृष्ट fr. rt. 1. मृज्, to
cleanse); मिष्टम् पयस्, water; (अम्), n. a sweet-
meat; a dainty or savoury dish.
—मिष्ट-कर्त्रि,
ता, त्री, तृ, a maker of dainties or delicacies, a
skilful cook.
—मिष्ट-पाचक, अस्, इका, अम्, cook-
ing savoury food or delicacies.
—मिष्ट-भुज्, क्, क्,
क्, an eater of dainties, eating delicacies.
—मिष्ट-
वाक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking pleasantly or agreeably.
—मिष्टान्न (˚ट-अन्˚), अम्, n. sweet or savoury
food, sweetmeats, sauce, gravy, seasoning, a mixture
of sugar and acids &c. eaten with rice or bread.
—मिष्टाशा (˚ट-आशा), f. desire for delicacies.

मिषमिषाय मिषमिषाय, Nom. A. मिष-
मिषायते, &c. (an onomatopoetic word), to crackle,
crepitate, make a crackling sound.
मिषिका, f. Nardostachys Jatamansi.
मिसरु, N. of a place.

मिसरू-मिश्र, अस्, m., N. of the author of the
Vivāda-candra.
